title: PRFeedbackSnapshotV1
description: Immutable, provider-neutral identity of the human pull-request feedback a remediation run answered. It records identities and content digests, never raw provider payloads; publication stages compare a live re-read against it and reject stale input.

provider.description: Repository provider kind the feedback was read from.

pullRequest.description: Pull request number the feedback belongs to.

headSHA.description: Exact full pull-request head SHA the feedback was captured at; part of the snapshot identity.

capturedAt.description: Capture time from the capturing host's clock; informational and excluded from the digest.

complete.description: Whether every feedback source was read in full; part of the digest input.

generalComments.description: Human general pull-request comments, ordered by id.

reviews.description: Human native review bodies with non-empty text, ordered by id.

reviewThreads.description: Review threads, ordered by thread id.

snapshotDigest.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of every field except capturedAt and snapshotDigest.

author.description: Provider-stable author identity, or display name where none exists.

inReplyTo.description: Provider-stable id of the comment this one replies to, when any.

bodySha256.description: sha256 of the comment body with line endings and surrounding whitespace normalized.

author.description: Review author identity; review state is excluded because providers rewrite it on push.

bodySha256.description: sha256 of the normalized review body.

outdated.description: Whether the thread was outdated against headSHA at capture.

contentDigest.description: sha256 over the thread's canonical human comments only.

comments.description: Human comments on the thread, ordered by id.
